director_name.description: Name of the Director resource to connect to; must match a defined Director in bconsole.conf

director_port.description: TCP port on which the Director listens; standard Bacula port is 9101

director_address.description: Hostname or IP address of the Director

director_password.description: Password used to authenticate the Console to the Director

director_catalog.description: Name of the Catalog resource to use for file listing; optional

director_auto_prune.description: Whether to automatically prune expired files and jobs (true/false); optional

catalogs.description: List of Catalog resources for file catalog queries; required if using -c catalog in bconsole CLI or referencing Catalog in Director resource. Each item defines DB connection parameters.

catalogs.items.db_port.description: Database server port; leave 0 for default (5432 for PostgreSQL, 3306 for MySQL)

messages_director_name.description: Name of the Director resource to receive messages from (e.g., 'bareos-dir'); optional

console_commands.description: List of custom console command definitions (name=value pairs); optional
